note: No earth-science group in the atlas; group left OTHER. The edge to the existing 'derivative' node is a real link: slope from contour spacing is a rate of change.

description.zh: 等高线是同一海拔的点连成的线：相邻两条差一个等高距，越密坡越陡，水沿垂直于等高线的最陡方向往低处流。仅为虚构光滑地形的教学模型。
description.en: Contour lines join points of equal altitude: neighbours differ by one contour interval, the closer they are the steeper the slope, and water runs downhill perpendicular to them. A teaching model on made-up smooth terrain.

label.en: Spacing is a rate of change

reason.zh: 相邻等高线海拔差固定，水平间距越短说明每走一米海拔变化越快，也就是坡度（导数的大小）越大。
reason.en: Neighbouring contours differ by a fixed height, so a shorter horizontal gap means altitude changes faster per metre travelled, i.e. a larger slope (the size of the derivative).

title.zh: 怎么从地图上看出哪里陡？
title.en: How can you tell from a map where it is steep?
